retained_capsule_checked_first.limitation: The retained v3 movie contains five kicks in empty space and cannot answer actor-contact state changes.

findings: A fresh Square edge while L2 or R2 is held arms timer -16 only when the player is grounded, player+0x5C is zero, and the prior action timer is nonnegative.
The signed action timer moves one unit toward zero per gameplay update. Negative selects animation 1.
Animation 1 at timer -7 through -2 emits ctor109 six times; timer -7 also emits ctor108.
Kick contact reuses actor body-contact broad-sphere and state/model ellipsoid geometry, then requires the actor in the player's forward half-plane and excludes animations 11, 12, and 30.
The immediate body-contact branch sets actor flag 0x1000 and bypasses normal player damage; that stage does not write actor HP.
The later ctor109 effect carries action class 1 into the generic enemy hit tail, where eligible targets receive HP minus 99 at 0x80059094/0x800590E4.
Actor flags 0x20 or 0x80 reject generic contact-object damage before geometry; actor flag 0x40 selects a kick-special reaction after contact and bypasses the HP dispatcher.
Normal reaction sets actor knockback 30 and player animation 30; actor flag 0x80 selects reduced knockback 15 instead.
The 0x80089938 lookup controls optional chase flag 0x2, not kick eligibility or damage immunity.
